name: plan-review
description: Reviews every plan-mode plan with the advisor-role model before it reaches the approval dialog: xd://propose stays blocked until a review finds no blockers, 2 review rounds are used, or you skip a running review with Esc or another interrupt of the turn; after the last round only the text it reviewed goes to approval, with later edits listed; open concerns go to approval in the plan file. Oh My Pi only.
